title: Well Smart EnergyPlus results
description: results.json written by the EnergyPlus runbook (references/toolchain.md) and read back by Cowork / Claude Code. run_status is the first thing a reader checks: a failed or not_run result carries error_message and no PASS of any kind; the report says 'not run' or 'failed', never PASS. design_* values are design-day sizing results (with the sizing factor applied) and are what S5 equipment selection uses; peak_* values are the annual-run peaks; annual_kWh is the energy result. compliance.verdict and vendor_duty_check[].status use the fixed vocabulary and are only meaningful when run_status is completed.

stage.description: loads = S3 sizing run; compliance = S7 Section J JV3 / NZ H1 run

run_status.description: completed = EnergyPlus finished with the output files present and hashed; failed = it started and did not finish; not_run = it was not started (name the missing input in error_message). Only completed may carry results.

error_message.description: Required when run_status is failed or not_run: the EnergyPlus error summary, or the missing input / reason. Never reported as PASS.

weather_file.description: EPW file name; its hash is in inputs_manifest

design_day_basis.description: Everything that fixes the sizing run besides the EPW; locked at S3 and cited by the equipment schedule

source.description: Where the design-day conditions come from: design-conditions station and edition, or the digest record id

outdoor_air_basis.description: Standard · year · clause / table and digest id used for outdoor air rates

latent_basis.description: Occupancy latent gains, infiltration and any process latent load basis

diversity.description: Block diversity applied to zone sums

sizing_factor.description: Applied to design_* values; 1.0 when none

design_cooling_kW.description: Design-day sizing result with the sizing factor applied

design_heating_kW.description: Design-day sizing result with the sizing factor applied

design_cooling_kW.description: Design-day block cooling load with diversity and sizing factor; the S5 selection basis

design_heating_kW.description: Design-day block heating load with diversity and sizing factor; the S5 selection basis

verdict.description: PASS only from a completed run whose evidence meets the criterion; NOT CALCULATED when the run failed or was not run

vendor_duty_check.description: One line per selected item of plant: the vendor's capacity and power at the project's design conditions against the design duty; filled from vendor documents at S5 / G4a, TBC until the vendor confirms

equipment_id.description: DB equipment id / tag, e.g. CH-01

design_duty_kW.description: The design_* load this item must meet

nominal_kW.description: Catalogue rating at the vendor's rating conditions

capacity_at_project_conditions_kW.description: Vendor-stated capacity at the design_day_basis conditions; null until confirmed

power_at_project_conditions_kW.description: Vendor-stated input power at the same conditions; null until confirmed

source.description: Vendor document_id / revision_id in the knowledge base, or TBC

status.description: PASS = confirmed capacity at project conditions ≥ design duty; TBC while the vendor has not replied

inputs_manifest.description: Every input file of the run with its SHA-256, so the result is bound to exact inputs (model.idf, EPW, schedules, generator script, DB export)

version.description: Tool or generator version when applicable
